rubric_items.reason: The api, web and db modules, both patient APIs and both tables are listed with statuses. It misses BookAppointmentPage, a second caller of GET /api/patients, and does not name the shared PatientListItem types.
Every module, API, table, index and symbol id is in the generated facts and cited. The 'only caller' statement has no fact behind it, because the generated facts hold no call graph.
Jobs are covered (none exist). Table readers and the medical-history path are covered. One caller of the changed list endpoint is missed: the BookAppointmentPage patient picker.
The changed and existing statuses are justified with cites. The 'only caller' guess is stated as fact. Saying the index 'covers' the lookup is a little strong, since status is not one of its columns.
Clear summary with the risks listed, a per-element status for each item, and a REQ-to-element mapping. Easy to read.
